easy_fields.name: EgoLife Dataset
easy_fields.creator: The EgoLife Team
easy_fields.citeAs: The EgoLife Team. EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant. arXiv preprint arXiv:2503.03803, 2025.
easy_fields.description: EgoLife is a comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation. It was collected from six participants living together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities using AI glasses and synchronized third-person-view video references. The dataset aims to lay the foundation for developing AI-powered egocentric life assistants.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper provides extensive details on the data collection, including participants, duration, environment, equipment, activities, and specific protocols for maintaining capture continuity and handling different modalities.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper thoroughly describes the annotation protocols for transcripts, captions, and QA, including the use of both human annotators and AI tools (GPT-4o, Whisper), quality control steps, and the types of annotations created.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper explicitly addresses ethical considerations, potential social impact (both positive and negative), intended use cases, and discusses limitations and challenges of the developed models.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper details data cleaning and preprocessing steps, including synchronization, de-identification (blurring, muting audio), and structuring recordings. It also mentions the ongoing nature of the project and plans for future versions, implying a maintenance plan.
